// dangerouslySetInnerHTML and innerHTML mentioned in a comment are not sinks.
import { lazy } from "react"
const LazyPanel = lazy(() => import("./local-panel"))
export function Clean({ el, img, text }: { el: HTMLElement; img: HTMLImageElement; text: string }) {
  const snapshot = el.innerHTML
  el.textContent = text
  img.src = "https://example.com/logo.png"
  const label = "innerHTML is a string here"
  return <span title={label} data-snapshot={snapshot}>{text}<LazyPanel /></span>
}
